# Feature request

## Production constraint

What production behaviour must remain intact?

## Staging capability

What should Mirrorling permit a developer to alter or observe?

## Handover boundary

Does the flow return to production? If so, identify the exact browser-side state that must survive and why.

## Runtime scope

Should this exist in local authoring, immutable Netlify deployment or both? State any payload, timeout or WebSocket requirement.

## Proof of completion

Describe the test or observable result that would establish the feature works.
